name: devices.list
description: List this device and directly connected devices. Use target="local".

name: sessions.list
description: List active streams and connection state on the explicit target.

name: screen.sources
description: List available native capture sources.

name: screen.start
description: Share a chosen native screen source with connected peers; audio is off.

name: screen.stop
description: Stop exactly the specified local shared video track.

name: screen.configure
description: Update a running stream; does not change persistent preferences.

name: control.acquire
description: Acquire control of a live native monitor stream. Reuses the same verified device's existing manual grant when its connection and capture match (reused=true), otherwise acquires exclusive automation control. Returns sourceId, physical bounds and geometryRevision for pointer operations.

name: control.bindWindow
description: Bind keyboard, text and pointer input to a top-level windowId returned as elementId by accessibility.windows. Requires acquired control and all keys/buttons released. Attempts foreground activation once; subsequent focus loss/window destruction stops input. Pointer points must belong to the visible bound window and acquired monitor. Bind once per control lease; release/acquire to change or remove binding. UIA semantic actions retain their explicit element targets.

name: control.release
description: Release this caller's input lease and held inputs. A reused manual control grant and its stream remain active.

name: control.screenshot
description: Capture a bounded PNG with image dimensions, physical desktop bounds, geometryRevision and imageToDesktop transform. Coordinates match UIA desktopPhysicalPixels; never apply DPI scale again. Refresh after display/window movement.

name: control.pointer
description: Mouse actions in desktopPhysicalPixels, bound to sourceId and geometryRevision from control.acquire. action is required: move jumps to x/y, or follows path from x/y; drag presses at x/y, follows path then releases. path has 1..128 waypoints; durationMs defaults to 500 (16..10000). down/up maintain button state across calls, with a 30-second hold limit. click supports clickCount 1..2, holdMs (default 30) and intervalMs (default 100). scroll requires scrollX and scrollY (120 units per detent, use 0 for the unused axis). Input actions execute serially. Cancellation, stale geometry or lost authority releases the affected control lease.

name: control.key
description: Operate named physical keys: press, down, up or ordered chord (reverse release). Timed actions default to holdMs=30, repeat=1, intervalMs=100; total scheduled duration <=10 seconds. Names are physical positions, not text. Held keys can combine with mouse actions; overlapping presses are rejected.

name: control.text
description: Type committed Unicode text into the focused application. Controls (including newline/Tab) require control.key. All held keys/buttons must first be released. Cancellable chunks preserve Unicode characters; intervalMs optionally spaces characters, with <=10 seconds of scheduled gaps.

name: accessibility.capabilities
description: Read desktop accessibility backend availability, supported semantic actions and limits.

name: accessibility.windows
description: List accessible top-level windows with opaque element references valid for up to 60 seconds. Excludes Weblink itself. Window names are sensitive.

name: accessibility.snapshot
description: Read a bounded, flat accessibility subtree from an elementId. Names may contain sensitive UI text; password controls are redacted. truncated means more nodes exist.

name: accessibility.action
description: Perform a supported semantic action on an elementId. Requires control.acquire and its active exclusive input lease. setValue requires value (empty clears); other actions forbid value. This can operate any application and is not limited to the acquired monitor. All caller element references expire after an action attempt; refresh windows/snapshot before further actions. No keyboard fallback.

name: commands.run
description: Run a noninteractive shell command and wait up to waitMs (default 10000, maximum 60000). Returns jobId, status, exitCode and the latest 16384 output bytes (chunks/startCursor/nextCursor), prioritizing final results/errors. If still running, background=true; continue commands.read with nextCursor. Use commands.read(cursor=0) for retained earlier output. timeoutMs independently limits process lifetime. Cancelling the call before handoff cancels the job.

name: commands.start
description: Start a noninteractive shell job in the background and return jobId immediately. Use commands.read(target,jobId) for the latest 16384 bytes, or tailLines/tailBytes for a smaller tail. Follow new output by passing nextCursor as cursor; poll until status is not running and hasMore=false. timeoutMs defaults to 60000, maximum 600000. stdout/stderr share one absolute byte cursor. Oldest output is evicted to retain the latest 4 MiB/8192 stream segments.

name: commands.status
description: Read job status (running/completed/cancelled/timed_out), exitCode, cumulative bytes, retainedBytes, earliestCursor, truncated (old output evicted), and outputIncomplete (pipe read failed or draining timed out). Does not return output; use commands.read for the latest output or incremental reads.

name: commands.read
description: Read the latest 16384 output bytes by default. Select only one of: tailBytes (1-16384), tailLines (1-1000 LF-delimited lines, still capped at 16384 bytes; tailLimited marks this cap), or cursor (absolute byte offset for incremental reads; 0 requests earliest retained output). Returns stdout/stderr chunks with display data and exact dataBase64, startCursor, nextCursor, hasMore, status, exitCode, cumulative bytes, retainedBytes, earliestCursor, truncated, cursorExpired, tailLimited and outputIncomplete (pipe read failed or draining timed out). Retain latest 4 MiB/8192 stream segments; old output is evicted. An expired cursor resumes at earliestCursor with cursorExpired=true. Follow with nextCursor; hasMore=false means caught up now, keep polling while running. Access requires the original caller and shell grant.

name: commands.cancel
description: Terminate your job and its process tree.

name: diagnostics.snapshot
description: Read latest redacted stream statistics and sample availability.

name: diagnostics.history
description: Read up to 30 samples after a cursor from the last five minutes.

name: diagnostics.start
description: Start a bounded detailed diagnostic capture without screen contents.

name: diagnostics.stop
description: Stop the detailed diagnostic capture.

name: diagnostics.export
description: Export a paginated redacted diagnostic report; no SDP, IPs, credentials or screen contents.
